text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh my. It seems my lung capacity has 
improved again. Fufu, I wonder how far I 
can go at this rate...)

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Gentile-san isn't coming back up!? Oh 
no! Is Gentile-san going to be okay!?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? You still had plenty left in the 
tank!? I-I'm so sorry! What incredible 
athletic ability...!
